ID: `mobbin-search`.

## What it does

Prepares search terms, the iOS or web platform and result count, then uses search_screens to open images returned by Mobbin. Describes only what it sees, such as fields, CTAs and screen structure. Answers bounded questions with a few references; for broader research, proposes an HTML collection and agrees its structure before building it. Each screen retains its product and source link.

## When to use it

Use it to understand how other products handle login, filters, onboarding or another pattern. A pattern appearing in an app does not prove its effectiveness for your audience. Style research and moodboard selection use the jado-visual-researcher procedure.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/search` in Claude Code or `$search` in Codex. Specify the problem, platform and desired number of references. Avoid imposing undecided details in the query. Request comparable observations and sources; if the result is a collection, define its grouping and destination.

## What it delivers

- Observed screenshots and Mobbin links
- Comparison of the patterns present
- An agreed HTML collection, if applicable

## Example

Find five web screens with complex table filters. Compare filter and reset action placement and link each example to Mobbin.

## Prerequisites

- Requires the Mobbin search_screens tool to be available. CDN images used in the HTML collection may expire after about an hour: the page is not a permanent archive.
